login.title: Administrator login
login.description: Log in with your administrator username and password.

profile.title: Edit profile
profile.description: Your name and username as an administrator. You stay logged in.
profile.usernameHint: 3 to 32 Latin letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Use it to log in from now on.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Enter your current password, then the new one. You stay logged in here; your other sessions end.
password.newHint: At least 8 characters, with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter and a digit.
password.done: Your password has been changed. Your other sessions have ended.

validation.fullNameLength: The name can be at most 100 characters.
validation.username: Use 3 to 32 Latin letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
validation.weakPassword: Use at least 8 characters, with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter and a digit.
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.

home.description: Choose a section from the side menu to manage plans and subscriptions.

plans.title: Subscription plans
plans.description: Plans set the clinic and device limits, duration and price of a subscription. Only active plans can be sold.
plans.empty: No plans have been created yet.

dialog.createDescription: A new plan can be sold right away.
dialog.editDescription: Subscriptions already sold keep the limits and price they were sold with.

fields.name: Plan name
fields.maxPurchasesHint: How many times each clinic owner may buy this plan in the desktop app. Empty or 0 means unlimited. Sales from this panel are not limited.
fields.activeHint: An inactive plan can no longer be sold; subscriptions sold from it stay as they are.

validation.nameLength: The plan name must be 1 to 100 characters.
validation.limit: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000.
validation.durationDays: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 3650.
validation.price: Enter the price in rials, using digits only.
validation.maxPurchases: Leave empty or enter a whole number from 0 to 1000.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Every subscription bought, newest first. Search by the clinic owner's name, username, identification code or phone, and open an owner to see their account, sell a subscription or cancel one.

search.label: Search subscriptions
search.placeholder: Name, username, identification code, phone or email

subscriptions.notFound: No user with identification code {{code}} was found.

list.title: Subscriptions
list.empty: This user has not bought a subscription yet.
list.openByCode: Open the account with identification code {{code}}

purchases.title: Completed purchases
purchases.description: Every purchase that added a subscription: payments approved in the app and sales recorded in the panel.
purchases.empty: This user has not completed any purchase yet.

payments.title: Payments not approved
payments.description: Payments this user reported in the app that are not approved: waiting for review, rejected or withdrawn. Approving one adds its subscription.
payments.empty: There are no payments that are not approved.

sell.title: Sell subscription
sell.description: Subscription for {{name}}. If a subscription is still in force, the new one starts when it ends.
sell.noPlans: There are no active plans. Create or activate one on the Plans page first.

cancel.title: Cancel subscription
cancel.description: The subscription "{{plan}}" ({{period}}) is canceled right now. If no other subscription is in force, this user's clinics lose access at once. This cannot be undone.

validation.noteLength: The note can be at most 500 characters.

delete.title: Delete subscription
delete.description: The subscription "{{plan}}" ({{period}}) is removed for good. If no other subscription is in force, this user's clinics lose access at once. This cannot be undone.
delete.purchased: It was bought in the desktop app, so its payment record is deleted too.

subscription.notFound: No subscription with this ID was found.

clinics.title: Clinics covered
clinics.description: The owner's clinics, oldest first. Clinic and device limits are measured against this subscription.

clinic.notFound: No clinic with this ID was found.

owner.title: Owner and subscription
owner.name: Clinic owner
owner.noSubscription: The owner has no subscription in force: nobody can log in on this clinic's devices.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Every device of this clinic, active ones first. The device limit is the one of the subscription in force, as checked at login.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Clinic owners transfer the amount to one of the payment accounts and report it in the app. Check each one against the bank statement, then approve it, which adds the subscription, or reject it with a reason the owner sees.

search.label: Search payments
search.placeholder: Name, username, identification code, phone, email or reference

payments.emptyPending: No payments are waiting for review.

details.amount: Amount to find on the statement
details.credit: Price {{price}}, less {{credit}} credit for the unused subscription.
details.freeHint: Nothing to pay, so it was approved automatically.

approve.title: Approve payment
approve.description: Approve only once this exact amount and reference appear on the account's bank statement. Approving adds the subscription at once.
approve.extend: The subscription starts when the owner's paid time ends, or now if none is left.
approve.upgradeNow: The subscription starts now and replaces the one in force; the unused part of that one was credited against the price.
approve.noteHint: Saved as the subscription's note. The owner does not see it.

reject.title: Reject payment
reject.description: No subscription is added. The owner sees the reason in the app and can report the payment again.
reject.reasonHint: Shown to the owner as written, e.g. "No transfer with this reference was received."

validation.reasonRequired: Write why the payment is rejected.
validation.reasonLength: The reason can be at most 500 characters.

paymentAccounts.title: Payment accounts
paymentAccounts.description: Bank accounts clinic owners can transfer subscription payments to. Owners see only active accounts, in position order.
paymentAccounts.empty: No payment accounts have been added yet. Owners cannot pay in the app until one is.

dialog.createDescription: Owners see it in the app right away.
dialog.editDescription: Payments already reported keep pointing to this account.

fields.holderNameHint: As the bank shows it, so owners can check it before paying.
fields.ibanHint: IR and 24 digits. Needed for bank transfers.
fields.positionHint: Accounts with a lower number are shown first.
fields.activeHint: An inactive account is no longer offered; payments already sent to it can still be reviewed.

validation.cardNumber: The card number must be 16 digits.
validation.iban: The IBAN must be IR followed by 24 digits.
validation.destinationRequired: Enter a card number, an IBAN, or both.

users.title: Users
users.description: Desktop app accounts, newest first. Panel administrators are not listed here.

search.label: Search users
search.placeholder: Name, username, identification code, phone or email

users.empty: No one has signed up yet.

delete.title: Delete user
delete.description: The account of {{name}} is deleted for good, with its subscriptions and payments, and its clinics with their devices, members and treatment records. Members of its clinics keep their own accounts. This cannot be undone.
delete.clinicsWarning: This account owns {{clinics}}. They are deleted too, with every record in them.

patients.title: Patients
patients.description: Patients the clinics have recorded and synced, newest first. Addresses, medical notes and treatments are not shown here.

search.label: Search patients
search.placeholder: Name, identification code, phone or email

errors.invalidInput: Some of the information entered is not valid.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
errors.serverUnreachable: Could not connect to the server. Check your network connection.
errors.serverUnavailable: The server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.unsupported: The server does not support this yet. Please update the server.
errors.planInactive: This plan is inactive and cannot be sold.
errors.paymentNotPending: This payment has already been reviewed, or the owner withdrew it.
errors.renewalQueued: Another subscription was sold after this upgrade was reported, so it cannot be applied now. Reject the payment instead.
errors.paymentAccountNotFound: This payment account no longer exists.
errors.weakPassword: The new password is too weak.
errors.passwordUnchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
